# ligo_binding (Data Source)

A binding: the access that a source has to a target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ligo_binding" "ledger_ci_read" {
  name = "ledger-ci-read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the binding.

### Read-Only

- `access_level` (String) The access level.
- `expires_at` (String) When it expires (RFC 3339), if it does.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `managed_by` (String) The SPIFFE ID of the automation that manages it (the lock); empty when nobody does.
- `message` (String) The last message of the workflow.
- `parameters` (String) The parameters of the access. As JSON text, in its normal form (sorted keys, no extra white space).
- `pending_change_request_id` (String) A change request of it that is still pending, if any.
- `phase` (String) PROVISIONING, ACTIVE, FAILED, DELETING or DELETE_FAILED.
- `platform` (String) The platform.
- `platform_jurisdiction` (String) The platform's jurisdiction.
- `platform_type` (String) The platform's type.
- `propagation_pending` (Boolean) Whether a change is still being propagated.
- `purpose` (String) Why it exists.
- `realm` (String) The realm.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update must name it.
- `source` (String) The source.
- `source_jurisdiction` (String) The source's jurisdiction.
- `target` (String) The target.
- `target_jurisdiction` (String) The target's jurisdiction.
